scope: MIMO-03 synchronous Windows CUDA GPU baseline; no cache/pipeline/API/MTP
workspace_note: Existing uncommitted MiMo and unrelated Hy3/Step work preserved; no commits or dependency archive edits.

manifest.scope: MiMo oracles, synthetic CUDA fixtures and optional synchronous selected-expert engine

build.command: cmake --build build-local/mimo2-cuda --target strata-mimo2 strata-mimo2-fixture-engine strata-mimo2-runtime-check strata-mimo2-kernels-check strata-mimo2-graph-check -j 8
build.note: Built in two invocations: engine/runtime first, numerical check targets second. Runtime header dependencies are explicit for localized MSVC/Ninja.

result.scope: synthetic native full/SWA GPU graph; no full-model inference
synthetic direct CUDA matrix/router operations; no full MiMo graph, model weights, pipeline or inference
result.tolerance_policy: declared before execution: F32 NMSE<=1e-10 and abs<=5e-5; BF16/quant (including activation rounding) NMSE<=1e-4 and abs<=0.02; router exact IDs, NMSE<=1e-10 abs<=2e-6
result.cpu_role: explicit test oracle only; CUDA graph executed directly without a fallback scheduler

result.scope: synthetic native MiMo graph, full/SWA128 masks and state; not full GGUF or inference throughput

python_tests.command: python -m unittest tools.test_mimo2_engine tools.test_mimo2_gguf tools.test_mimo2_tokenizer tools.test_mimo2_cuda tools.test_step35_tokenizer tools.test_hy3_tokenizer tools.test_glm5next_tokenizer

engine_corpus.note: Before counter-only error-path correction and extracted EOS predicate; source hashes embedded in report.

engine_repeat.command: python -m tools.check_mimo2_engine --build build-local/mimo2-cuda --model H:\models\mimo-v2.6-flash\MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL-GSQ-RCO-3.5bit.gguf --suite repeat --output-dir build-local/mimo2-validation/full-repeat --cuda-bin build-local/cuda-13.0/bin/x64 --timeout 1800
